metadata.verified_commit_note: verified_commit is 7ed124d, which expanded ShapEMeshResult accessors and shifted later ShapERuntime.swift line ranges. This docs commit is a follow-up that retargets those anchors. The checker does not use git history. It does not require verified_commit to equal HEAD or to be an ancestor of HEAD. Every cited line is checked against the working tree, including a source token named after the citation when the sentence has one.
metadata.mlx_swift_constraint: "0.31.3"..<"0.31.5"; Package.resolved pins 0.31.3 (revision 61b9e011e09a62b489f6bd647958f1555bdf2896). Capped below 0.31.5 because 0.31.5+ requires swift-tools-version 6.3.
metadata.content_hash_note: content_hashes are SHA-256 of markdown line-range citations, joined by newlines with a trailing newline. Swift symbol citations and knowledge-graph symbol nodes are not hashed.

nodes.summary: Library product. Depends on MLX and MLXNN. Processes MarchingCubes.metal as a resource.
Executable product. Depends on ShapERuntime and MLX.
Unit-test target. Copies Tests/ShapERuntimeTests/Fixtures into the test bundle.
ShapECLI --image-parity dump. Expects python_*.npy inputs that are not in this repository.
Projects a latent of rank 2, shape [B, D], into NeRF-STF parameter tensors.
Image-conditioned diffusion transformer. Same predict contract family as Text300M, loaded lazily.
CGImage to CLIP NHWC input. processCLIPImage returns float32 [1, 224, 224, 3].
Maps Karras sigma to the diffusion timestep schedule stored in the bundle and calls the transformer.
Heun-style Karras sampler. ShapERuntime passes latent shape (batchSize, dLatent) from the artifact.
CPU marching cubes. extract takes an SDF [X, Y, Z] and returns verts [V, 3] and faces [F, 3].
Writes a Wavefront OBJ. Vertices are float triples. Faces are 0-based in memory and written 1-based.
Counts boundary, non-manifold, and invalid edges for the CLI mesh A/B report.
Metal marching cubes. Loads countTriangles and extractMesh from Bundle.module and shares LookupTable with the CPU path.
CLIP vision transformer. embedImagesGrid consumes a normalized image tensor.
CLIP BPE tokenizer. encode and tokenize read bpe_simple_vocab_16e6.txt.gz.
CLIP text transformer. embedText returns a float tensor of shape [batch, textProjectionDim].
Required bundle paths: manifest.json, the BPE file, and manifest tensor paths for the text or full scope.
Checks that manifest.json, the CLIP BPE file, and scoped tensor blobs exist. Checksums are enforced by fetch_weights.py.
Loads manifest.json and the tensor families. n_ctx and d_latent come from family metadata, not from hardcoded production sizes.
Queries the NeRF-STF field and extracts meshes. Default query batch is 65536. Chooses CPU or Metal marching cubes.
Public mesh result. verticesArray is [Float] length V*3. facesArray is [Int32] length F*3.
End-to-end text and image mesh runtime. Loads the bundle, CLIP text, Text300M, the Karras denoiser, the decoder projector, and the STF renderer. Image weights load on the first image call.
Owned tensor blob with a name, shape, data type, and bytes.
Reads raw little-endian tensor blobs named by the manifest.
Text-conditioned diffusion transformer. predict takes [B, inputChannels, T] and returns [B, outputChannels, T]. Configuration is inferred from weight shapes. Convenience init defaults nHeads to 16.
Swift source file, 38 lines. Round-trips mesh scalar accessors and proves out-of-range Int64 faces throw.
Metal kernels countTriangles and extractMesh. Bundled via Package.swift resources.
